QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (default, `mbedtls_config.h:208` is commented out) | `calloc` via macro, no indirection
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build `mbedtls_calloc` resolves to `calloc` via a macro with no indirection. It also says the default is "plain libc `calloc`/`free`", which covers `free`.
